items.source: Note: HandlerAdapter implementors may implement the Ordered interface to be able to specify a sorting order (and thus a priority) for getting applied by the DispatcherServlet. Non-Ordered instances get treated as the lowest priority.
items.translation: 注意：HandlerAdapter 实现者可以实施Ordered接口，以便指定由DispatcherServlet应用的排序顺序（即优先级）。非 Ordered 实例被视为最低优先级。

items.source: Interface that must be implemented for each handler type to handle a request. This interface is used to allow the DispatcherServlet to be indefinitely extensible. The DispatcherServlet accesses all installed handlers through this interface, meaning that it does not contain code specific to any handler type.
items.translation: 每个处理程序类型必须实现的接口，用于处理请求。该接口允许DispatcherServlet无限扩展。DispatcherServlet通过此接口访问所有已安装的处理程序，因此其中不包含针对任何特定处理程序类型的代码。

items.source: Note that a handler can be of type Object. This is to enable handlers from other frameworks to be integrated with this framework without custom coding, as well as to allow for annotation-driven handler objects that do not obey any specific Java interface.
items.translation: 注意，处理器可以是 `Object` 类型。这是为了能够在不编写自定义代码的情况下，将其他框架的处理器集成到此框架中，同时也允许使用注解驱动的处理器对象，这些对象无需遵循任何特定的 Java 接口。

items.source:
This interface is not intended for application developers. It is available
to handlers who want to develop their own web workflow.
items.translation: 此接口并非专为应用程序开发人员设计。它可供希望自行开发 Web 工作流的处理器使用。

items.source: Given a handler instance, return whether this HandlerAdapter can support it.
items.translation: 给定一个处理器实例，返回此HandlerAdapter是否可以支持它。

items.source: Use the given handler to handle this request.
items.translation: 使用给定的处理器处理此请求。

items.source:
Use the given handler to handle this request.
The workflow that is required may vary widely.
items.translation:
使用给定的处理器来处理此请求。
所需的工作流可能差异很大。

items.source: handler - the handler to use. This object must have previously been passed to the supports method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: `handler` - 要使用的处理器。此对象必须已传递给该接口的 `supports` 方法，且该方法必须返回 `true`。

items.source: Exception - in case of errors
items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时

items.source: a ModelAndView object with the name of the view and the required model data, or null if the request has been handled directly
items.translation: 包含视图名称和所需模型数据的 ModelAndView 对象，或者如果请求已被直接处理则为 `null`。

items.source: whether this object can use the given handler
items.translation: 该对象是否可以使用给定的处理器
